scientific_integrity: The elementary transition simulation is proved directly; source q=4 bounds are used as established literature. Finite checker does not establish infinite asymptotics. No authorship or independent certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Optimized reversible transitions and fixed error margins; exact noise-free simulation, no gate locality, no optimal overhead constants; possible unindexed prior reduction remains.
title: Two positive transition letters attain sharp quantum and classical bounded-word Hankel identification laws
